title: A Song of Ice and Fire

provenance.edgeDefinition: characters named within 15 words of each other
provenance.weightSemantics: count of qualifying co-occurrences, summed across all five books

attribution.title: Character Interaction Networks for A Song of Ice and Fire
attribution.creator: Andrew Beveridge and Jie Shan
attribution.citation: A. Beveridge and J. Shan, “Network of Thrones”, Math Horizons 23(4), 2016, pp. 18–22.
modifications: Merged the five per-book edge lists into one graph, summing tie weights across books.
Derived display names from the dataset's hyphenated identifiers.
Applied a hand-maintained identity table covering 28 characters: display names, nicknames for the guess field, and disambiguators.
Dropped ties weaker than 1 and characters with fewer than 2 ties, then kept the largest connected component (796 nodes and 2823 ties in, 592 and 2619 out).
Added a normalised rank per tie endpoint so thickness reads relative to each character's own ties rather than raw counts.
Computed a force-directed layout for the full graph, used by the reveal animation.
